title: reusable cloth bowl covers
text: reusable cloth bowl covers. I purchased these to compliment my rustic bread making project - these are terrific and the perfect size for the glass bowls I use.  I purchased 2 sets of 3.  With each set you get 1 small, 1 medium and 1 larger.  They are cotton and elastic edged. An ivory and blue stripe.  I recommend using scent free laundry soap when washing. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
